Act as the review sub-agent for this task.

You are a Senior Code Reviewer. Review round 4 of an implementation plan + spec (no implementation code exists yet). Prior rounds fixed many issues; verify the claimed fixes below and hunt for remaining gaps. Be strict on Critical/Important; be lenient on Minor (they may be skipped).

FILES (repo root C:\Project\ninfs-mcp, read both fully first): docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-08-ninfs-mcp.md (rev4), docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-07-ninfs-mcp-design.md (rev5).

PRIOR 'No' HAD 3 Critical + 11 Important + 2 Minor. CLAIMED FIXES THIS ROUND:
C1. TMD version via signature-aware parse (header_start+0x9C u16BE), unknown-sig/short-file exclusion, signed-fixture test.
C2. On-mount hierarchy <mp>/<ID1>/title/... (no ID0); raw-SD vs mount paths separated.
C3. ExeFS success evidence = code-decompressed.bin presence only (pyctr always registers it on success); stdout always DEVNULL, no token scanning; absent -> error, no .code fallback.
I4. Per-kind readiness entries (sd ID1 dirs, sdtitle tmd.bin, ncch exefs.bin, exefs decompressed/code.bin).
I5. InternalMount.session_id ownership; deleted-ID unmount routes to residuals else unknown-id error.
I6. Staging dirs under NINFS_WORKSPACE/.mounts; unmount success = proc dead + staging empty; idempotent stop, single terminate, no escalation.
I7. Runner keeps sd_root in session for all sanitize calls incl. post-invalidation errors.
I8. Same-parent-dir unique tmp + os.replace atomic overwrite; tmp removed on failure/cancel; existing file kept; handle invalidated.
I9. ExtractResult/UnmountSummary fully defined; detect_sd dict-return documented as stateless-query exception.
I10. Lowercase IDs, high-8 must be 00040000, explicit-update-ID resolves directly without base fallback.
I11. Update completeness = parseable TMD + non-empty content/; broken update falls back to base.
I12. ninfs==2.0 pinned, pyctr version recorded, per-package pip index, python -m unified, pytest pin+install explicit.
I13. Global RLock serializes runner ops; cancel runs to safe point.
I14. Workspace/SD overlap + secret-file-dest rejection.
M15/16. One action per checkbox; rev labels; manual Task 6 for live-device check.

SPEC CONTEXT: Windows+WinFsp, stdio, ninfs 2.0 CLI via subprocess only (-f always, stdout DEVNULL, stderr drain thread 64KB), 5 tools, runner-internal types mapped to public dicts by server, read-only enforced, get_secrets()+session paths sanitizer, two-stage path checks, mocked tests only, Native execution, Tasks 1-5 TDD + Task 6 manual, per-commit security-audit quick + final independent review.

CHECKS: (a) each claimed fix is real and sufficient; (b) no new contradictions; (c) Task 1 (packaging+policy+CLI verify) is fully startable as written -- flag anything that would stop an implementer on Task 1; (d) type/key consistency; (e) remaining spec-silent behaviors.

OUTPUT: ### Strengths; ### Issues (#### Critical/Important/Minor with file:line+why+fix); ### Recommendations; ### Assessment (Ready: Yes/No/With fixes + reason, PLUS an explicit line: "Task 1 startable: Yes/No" with reason). Before verdict list out-of-scope items one line each with reason. Read-only: mutate nothing, spawn no subagents.
